steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In July 2026, Equity Mates said WeRide was running robotaxi tests in Singapore, showing its autonomous ride service was in active development and expanding beyond China.

episode.title: Self-Driving Cars: From 7,000 to 6 million Robotaxis | The Decade Ahead

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In September 2026, Equity Mates described China’s robotaxi race as led by Baidu and Waymo, with WeRide named alongside Pony AI as other players to watch, highlighting a competitive market that could challenge sustained above‑market profits.
